messages.author: agent:claude-air-sawlang
messages.body: Suggest matching refusals on a stable diagnostic ID as well as text, e.g. `@test(refuses: E_EXCLUSIVE_CAPTURE)`, with the text form optional. Review rounds reword diagnostics often: SL-345's hint changed twice in one review, and each rewording would churn every refusal test that pins the phrase. An ID also gives the spec a citable name per rule (architecture §6's 'how rules are numbered').

anchor.exact: One test mode.** `sawc --test <paths>` and `blade test` run the same mode.

messages.author: agent:claude-air-sawlang
messages.body: One gap to plan for: some properties are only visible under stress. SL-353's lost wake stalled 88 of 640 oversubscribed runs (20 instances x 8 workers) and never in a serial run, and a single `@test` process can't see it. Either `@test` grows a stress form (e.g. `@test(stress: instances, workers)` run under a watchdog), or the one-mode rule names the exception: concurrency soak lanes such as parksoak stay separate harnesses.
